tasks.title: Set up the channel + Instagram and post "hello"
tasks.why: The channel has to exist before launch day.

Photo each one.

tasks.title: Make the 15-second launch video (exact shot list inside)
tasks.why: It goes out with the launch post on Fri 2 Oct.
steps: WATCH FIRST: HQ's Haven video (link below). Copy its style: a cut every 1–2 seconds, warm orange colours, big friendly text.
FORMAT: vertical 1080×1920, 30 fps, 15 s, MP4. Edit in CapCut (free). Music: CapCut library tracks marked for commercial use only.
TEXT: big Uzbek captions in the middle of the screen (never in the bottom 20% — the app covers it). Font: Nunito Black or Jua (design/fonts).
SHOTS: follow the shot table below, second by second.
RECORD JUMPIO: play it at notazizelse.itch.io/jumpio and record 20 s with Win+Alt+R (Xbox Game Bar) or your phone.
0.0–2.0 s: Jumpio: the character jumps across a gap (screen recording) — text: “2 kunda o'z o'yiningni yarat”
2.0–4.0 s: Close-up: hands on a keyboard, code on the screen (film a friend) — text: “13–18 yosh · kod bilish shart emas”
4.0–7.0 s: Jumpio again — a different level, collecting / landing — text: “Bepul · 14–15-noyabr · Toshkent”
7.0–10.0 s: 2–3 quick clips from HQ's Haven video (1 s each) — text: “Dunyoning 200+ shahrida bir vaqtda”
10.0–12.0 s: Flyer_Uz.png slides in from the right — text: “Do'stlaring bilan kel”
12.0–15.0 s: End card: orange background + haven-logo-orange.png — text: “haven.hackclub.com/tashkent”
tasks.done_when: The MP4 + one cover frame (PNG) posted in 📣 Social Media, and Kumush says OK.
tasks.ask: Kumush — caption text; Saidazizxon — logo + colours

Check it printed in grey — no light text on colour.

rules.title: Reply within 24 hours
rules.text: Even if it's just "on it". Silence is the only wrong answer.

rules.title: Every task ends in proof
rules.text: A photo, a link, a file, a name + number. "Done" without proof isn't done.

rules.title: Report in the Team Hub
rules.text: Press Start when you begin, Done + proof when you finish. That's the whole reporting system.

rules.title: Stuck? Press Blocked the same day
rules.text: Write what you need. Blocked 48 h → it goes to Azizbek. Asking early is never wrong.

rules.title: Can't make a date? Say so before it passes
rules.text: Moving a date is fine. Missing it silently is not.

rules.title: No decisions in DMs
rules.text: If it's decided, it goes in the group. Otherwise we argue it again in three weeks.

rules.title: Never announce anything unconfirmed
rules.text: Venue, prizes, sponsors, partners — only after Azizbek confirms in writing.

rules.title: Never promise a sponsor anything
rules.text: You open the door; Azizbek negotiates.

rules.title: Minors' data: name only
rules.text: Don't collect phone numbers, schools, photos or anything else without Azizbek's OK.

rules.title: Never criticise NASA Space Apps
rules.text: Different age, different thing. We say that and move on.
